claims: Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess hypercapnic respiratory acidosis (pH 7.25-7.27, pCO2 54-55) and guide ventilatory support.
Maintain close monitoring of respiratory status including continuous pulse oximetry and frequent respiratory rate checks given hypercapnia and tachypnea risk.
Continue supplemental oxygen therapy titrated to maintain SpO2 above 88-92% desaturation limit.
Recheck serum magnesium given prior hypomagnesemia (1.5 mg/dL) and active magnesium repletion to confirm normalization.
Monitor blood pressure closely given hypotension (arterial BP 91/78, mean 84) and adjust vasoactive or fluid therapy as needed.
Continue epidural analgesia infusion and monitor pain control and sensory/motor function.
Continue PCA hydromorphone for pain management and monitor PCA usage and pain scores.
Perform daily assessment of Braden score and implement pressure injury prevention measures (skin care, repositioning).
Encourage incentive spirometry and cough/deep breathing exercises to prevent atelectasis and support ventilation.
Monitor blood glucose given hyperglycemia (130-131 mg/dL) and active insulin therapy.
